title: On The Hook standalone React Native customer mobile app
description:
Complete the On The Hook Fish & Chips customer app as a fully working standalone React Native application for iOS. The release architecture uses bundled production content, including the supplied schedule JSON, plus native OS integrations for directions, calendar, foreground location, and local notifications.

No private OTH backend, bootstrap API, schedule API, menu/about API, staging server, mock HTTP service, runtime website scraping, APNs/FCM application server, or mandatory account system is required for this release. Ordering remains an external handoff only when an explicit approved URL exists.
acceptance_criteria:
- All remaining child beads are complete and closed.
- Core app launches and works without a private OTH backend/API.
- Home, Find Us, Menu, About, More, and Contact use bundled production content.
- Find Us uses the supplied bundled schedule snapshot and handles expired/no-upcoming data honestly.
- Directions use the OS maps handoff; calendar uses local device integration.
- Notification behavior for this release is local-device only and does not require a push server.
- No runtime website scraping, native ordering/cart/checkout, fabricated order URL, or mandatory account flow exists.
- iOS share the React Native implementation; unavailable platform runners do not block code completion.
- Official app icon/brand assets are present before release.
notes: All children are now closed, deferred, or blocked. Remaining blockers are external: first-party production API/push scheduler, approved official brand masters, map/calendar implementation decisions, and macOS iOS device/simulator validation.

title: Finish standalone Find Us discovery and optional map behavior
description:
Finish the standalone Find Us experience using the bundled production schedule snapshot. The canonical experience is searchable/filterable list -> Event Detail. An embedded map is optional and must never block the release.

The current schedule snapshot contains formatted addresses but does not guarantee latitude/longitude. Do not require API-supplied coordinates and do not bulk-geocode addresses. Directions should hand the selected formatted address to the OS maps application.
acceptance_criteria:
- Find Us browses all future events from the bundled schedule snapshot.
- Search matches city, state, venue, and formatted address.
- State/date filtering and clear/reset behavior work.
- Events sort sensibly by date/time and location.
- Location permission is optional; manual browsing/search always works when denied.
- Distances are not fabricated when coordinates are unavailable.
- Embedded map UI is shown only if reliable coordinates already exist; otherwise the list is the complete supported experience.
- Directions opens the OS maps mechanism using the formatted address.
- No bulk client-side geocoding and no OTH backend/API are required.
notes: Blocked: no approved map SDK/provider, API key configuration, or valid-coordinate fixture coverage is present. The app must not geocode client-side as a substitute.

title: Build standalone local Notification Settings screen
description:
Provide notification settings for the standalone release using only local device state. Support OS permission status, locally persisted reminder preferences, event reminder enable/disable behavior, and a link to system settings when permission is denied/restricted.

Do not register push tokens, sync preferences to a backend, or claim that the app can receive newly published schedules/cancellations from a server.
acceptance_criteria:
- Screen reflects real OS notification permission state.
- Permission is requested only after explicit user action.
- Denied/restricted state links to OS settings and does not repeatedly prompt.
- User reminder preferences persist locally across app restarts.
- Local reminders can be scheduled/canceled for bundled schedule events where supported.
- No push token, backend registration, APNs/FCM application server, or preference-sync API is required.
- Copy accurately describes local reminder capability and does not promise live server-driven schedule updates.
notes: Blocked by mobile push synchronization (oth-mobile.26). The pre-permission UI exists, but backend-synced settings and disable registration cannot be implemented without the missing API.

title: Accessibility pass for iOS VoiceOver
description: Perform an end-to-end accessibility pass for the standalone v1 screens and shared controls after Find Us and local Notification Settings are complete. Accessibility must not depend on an embedded map or backend-driven features.
acceptance_criteria:
- Interactive controls expose meaningful labels, roles, values, and states.
- External links announce that they leave the app where practical.
- Find Us is fully usable through the list/search/detail experience; no map interaction is required.
- Dynamic Type/font scaling does not clip primary actions.
- Text/control contrast meets the intended WCAG AA target.
- Reduce Motion is honored where custom motion exists.
- Manual VoiceOver checklist is completed when an iOS-capable environment is available; code-level accessibility is not blocked by lack of that environment.
notes: Blocked pending completion of all screens and manual VoiceOver/Reduce Motion validation on an iOS Simulator or device, which requires the macOS/Xcode environment.

title: Implement privacy-conscious analytics taxonomy
description: Implement the privacy-conscious analytics abstraction for the standalone app. The default production configuration may use a no-op analytics adapter. Analytics must never be required for app startup or any customer feature.
acceptance_criteria:
- Navigation, Find Us discovery, directions, calendar, menu category, notification setup, external links, and local data-state events can be emitted through one typed abstraction.
- Default/no-provider configuration is a no-op and does not block any feature.
- No precise coordinates, notification tokens, email/phone, raw free-text search, or full external order URL are emitted.
- Tests verify sensitive fields are excluded.
- No analytics backend is required for release acceptance.
notes: Blocked from final acceptance until unavailable map/calendar/push features exist; implemented no-op privacy-filtered taxonomy covers available app, discovery, directions, menu, notification, external, and order events.

title: Configure standalone iOS permissions capabilities and branding
description:
Configure the iOS target for the standalone release: bundle/app metadata, foreground location usage description, local notification permission behavior, calendar behavior required by the selected library, safe external URL handling, app icon/splash from approved brand assets, and release signing configuration.

Do not require remote push registration, APNs application-server configuration, a private OTH API, or an embedded maps SDK when OS maps handoff is sufficient.
acceptance_criteria:
- iOS target builds/launches on an available supported environment.
- Only foreground location permission is declared for current features.
- Local notification permission/reminder behavior works without remote push registration.
- Calendar permission/intent wording matches actual implementation.
- Directions use an OS maps handoff without requiring a private OTH backend.
- App icon/splash use approved On The Hook brand art, including docs/mobile-icon.png where intended.
- Info.plist privacy strings match actual behavior.
- Absence of an iOS runner on a non-macOS machine is documented, not treated as an implementation blocker.
notes: Blocked pending approved official logo/icon/splash master, calendar implementation decision, and APNs backend/push registration configuration. Current Info.plist only declares foreground location.

title: Configure standalone iOS permissions capabilities and branding
description:
Configure the iOS app for the standalone release: package/app metadata, iOS 13+ local notification permission behavior, foreground location permission, calendar behavior, safe external URL/deep-link handling, and adaptive icon/splash from approved brand assets.

Do not require FCM application-server configuration, a private OTH backend, or a Google Maps SDK/API key when OS maps handoff is sufficient.
acceptance_criteria:
- iOS app builds/launches on an available supported emulator/device.
- No background location permission is declared.
- current iOS notification permission supports local reminders without a push server.
- Directions use the OS maps mechanism without requiring a maps SDK key for core functionality.
- Calendar behavior works through the selected local intent/library approach.
- Adaptive icon/splash use approved On The Hook brand art.
- Info.plist contains only permissions required by implemented standalone features.
- No FCM server, OTH backend, or remote schedule service is required.
notes: iOS-only scope is documented for this archived record.

title: Standalone performance and image optimization pass
description: Profile and optimize startup, local schedule loading/filtering, list scrolling, image decoding, navigation, and memory usage for the standalone application. Optimize without degrading brand fidelity. Do not introduce a backend or map SDK merely to satisfy performance testing.
acceptance_criteria:
- Find Us remains responsive with at least 250 deterministic local event records.
- Event/menu rows are virtualized or otherwise avoid unnecessary re-renders.
- Bundled images use appropriate dimensions/compression for rendered size.
- No synchronous bulk geocoding exists.
- No runaway polling, background network task, or backend retry loop exists.
- Startup does not wait on remote OTH content.
notes: Blocked pending instrumented iOS device/simulator profiling and map implementation; photo resizing is complete but end-to-end performance targets require Xcode tooling.

title: Final standalone visual polish and cross-platform parity pass
description: Complete final visual polish for the standalone React Native app after accessibility and performance work. Compare Home, Find Us, Menu, About, More, Contact, Event Detail, and Notification Settings against the design specification at representative iOS sizes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Home/Find Us/Menu/More and secondary screens feel visually coherent and branded.
- No clipped text or unreachable actions at target widths/font sizes.
- Safe areas and iOS insets are correct.
- External-link indicators and button hierarchy are consistent.
- Decorative assets are used sparingly and intentionally.
- Behavior is verified on iOS.
- Missing device/simulator infrastructure for one platform does not create a fake product blocker; platform-specific validation still remains documented.
notes: iOS-only scope is documented for this archived record.
